notes: AXIS MAPPING: ASUS publishes closed-state Dimensions (W x D x H) = 31.35 x 21.79 x 1.46 ~ 1.99 cm; manufacturer WIDTH 313.5 mm -> closed.width, manufacturer DEPTH 217.9 mm -> closed.height, manufacturer HEIGHT/thickness -> closed.depth. closed.width is the LONG axis, opposite the phone-vendor convention. Values converted cm -> mm (x10) keeping ASUS's precision. THICKNESS RANGE RESOLVED: the tech-spec page gives a range '1.46 ~ 1.99 cm' and does not say what the two ends mean; the ASUS press release resolves it by stating '31.3 x 21.7 x 1.46 cm (without Bluetooth keyboard)', so 14.6 mm is the laptop's own closed thickness and 19.9 mm is the stack with the detachable keyboard attached. 14.6 mm is recorded; 19.9 mm is NOT recorded anywhere as a separate field. mass_g = 1350 g = the 1.35 kg 'Weight of system' (the dual-screen laptop itself); ASUS's headline 1.65 kg is the system PLUS the 0.30 kg detachable Bluetooth keyboard, and 0.30 + 1.35 = 1.65 kg. kg->g conversion is x1000 exactly. dimensions_mm.open null - ASUS publishes no opened/lay-flat dimension for the Duo. TWO DISCRETE PANELS (not a fold), roles primary + secondary, identical. active_area_mm derived from sourced diagonal + resolution assuming square pixels: 14.0 x 2880 / sqrt(2880^2+1800^2) x 25.4 = 301.5 mm wide, 188.5 mm high. HINGE: hinge.type is 'clamshell' with max_angle_deg 180, NOT 'dual_screen_360' - ASUS documents a 'lay-flat 180 degree hinge' and nowhere claims 360 degrees, so dual_screen_360 would be unsupported. free_stop null - not documented. PORTS: ASUS also lists '1x USB 3.2 Gen 1 Type-A', which is OMITTED from ports[] because SPEC's port kind enum (usb_c|headphone_3_5|microsd|hdmi|sim) has no usb_a member. Thunderbolt 4 recorded as usb_c. Port left/right position null - the ASUS tech-spec page states no side for any port. materials.back / cover_glass null - ASUS states no back or cover-glass material. released null - no full release date on an ASUS page. ASUS's tech-spec page also lists an alternative FHD (1920 x 1200) 60Hz OLED panel option for this series; the 3K 120Hz panel recorded here is the one ASUS's own press release headlines for UX8406.
